title: creepebucketlib
description: A responsive UI & Animation Library for Minecraft NeoForge.
body:
Creepebucketlib is a Minecraft NeoForge UI library built for responsive design and animations, providing developer-friendly UI components and a robust animation system.

With just a few lines of code, you can create custom UI components that automatically trigger animations and custom logic based on events. These components dynamically recalculate their dimensions and positions according to the screen size, and adding animations to them is effortless. Furthermore, the library offers convenient data synchronization, client-triggered server-side hooks, and comprehensive documentation.
